title: We Saved You a Plate
sections: Verse 1
Four hundred miles with a speech in my head
I said it to the windshield, I said it to the dash
Wore out every sorry till the words went thin
Took the exit that I swore I'd never take again
Sat in the driveway till the coffee went cold
Porch light still burning on a bulb ten winters old
Pre-chorus 1
I put it in reverse, I almost let it roll
Then Mama came out drying off a mixing bowl
Chorus 1
And she said we saved you a plate
We saved you a plate
Come on in out of the cold
Your chair's where it was
We saved you a plate
Verse 2
Nobody asked me where I'd been
Uncle Ray's asleep with the game up loud again
The little ones are taller than I'd ever guess
Somebody hands me a baby in a Christmas dress
And there's my name in glitter on a stocking on the wall
Still hanging with the others like I never left at all
Pre-chorus 2
Nobody stopped eating, the plates went round the same
Daddy just passed the cornbread and he said my name
Chorus 2
And he said we saved you a plate
We saved you a plate
Come on in out of the cold
Your chair's where it was
We saved you a plate
Bridge
I started on my sorry, I said Mama, all this time
She said hush now, baby, you're right on time
You're right on time
Hush now, you're right on time
Chorus 3
We saved you a plate
We saved you a plate
Come on in out of the cold
Your chair's where it was
We saved you a plate
note: Banked hold-out (song 63). Lead words only; the last chorus's echoes in brackets in lyric_locked.md are for a backing choir. Not run: no room check, no build.
